basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 3-story single-family home located in San Francisco's vibrant Bayview neighborhood! With 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,681 sq. ft. of space, this home offers both comfort and flexibility for a variety of lifestyles. The main level features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 updated bathroom, living room with wood burning fireplace, formal dining which can be converted the 3rd bedroom, beautiful eat-in kitchen complete with stainless steel appliances, Quartz countertops & backsplash. The lower level offers a full bathroom, family room, office and 1 bedroom on the level below. 1-car garage on ground level. Step outside to a large backyard perfect for BBQ, entertaining or simply relaxing with family and friends. Property is ideally situated with easy access to Muni, 1 block away from 3rd street, and just minutes from SF Downtown, and SFO. Whether you're looking for a perfect starter home or a smart investment. Zoned RH-2 which can be applied for 2 legal units. A must see!
